name: Breaker-failure retrip output
summary: Issues the documented repeat opening request before the assigned backup trip action.
description: Issues the documented repeat opening request before the assigned backup trip action. A protection scheme combines measurements, decision elements and communication or trip outputs to protect a defined part of the network. A function number names a job; the scheme interface shows how that job connects to other equipment.

In a substation feeder bay, local current and voltage measurements may combine with a remote-end signal before the protection issues the assigned trip request. Backup actions use their own defined initiations and supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Breaker-failure state” at the input and “Assigned breaker retrip” at the output. Retrip and upstream backup have different destinations.
